svg.text: Each original profile is cloned 5x. Per stage: 20 g=0 share nodes + 5 g=1 unshare nodes. Route/topology/distribution inherited from 4/5.
Gold: FS = descendant child-subtree all g=0; SL = g=0 share leaf
Edges = route-label continuations inherited from original 4/5 tree
Profile clone count = 5; share ratio = 4/5 at every stage
